title: Knight's Avatar Saver & Explorer V2 [FREE, KEYLESS, NO KEY].
features:
My Personal Tool for Conquering and Exploring Varieties of Avatars or Outfits.

• Experimental script, use at your own risk.
• Disclaimer❗: This script keeps players UserIDs, Usernames, and DisplayName(stored locally or IS NOT shared through link/upload/shared externally) for labeling and properly organizing Avatar properties purposes only(❗Do not try to do what sort of illegal/inappropriate things that would violate players account informations/reputation❗).
• Tested only on Delta Executor and Android Phone Device Screen Sizing. Desktop or other Executors might Encounter Issues.
• Credits: This script is inspired by a open source Catalog Avatar Creator script created by @1954real and @mewt.

FEATURES:
- Free
- Click to Save Avatar
- Interactive UIs and Displays
- Avatar Catalogs(Saves, Players in Server, Friends) and Previews.
- Inspect all Avatars
- Support all Asets
- Save Avatars Permanently
- Minimizable, Dragable, Destroyable, Re-executable Script/UI/Instance.
- Wear Avatars in Catalog Avatar Creator
- All about Outfit Stealing

TIPS:
- Avoid showing off stealing, they can report you.
- Let me know if there are bugs or issues or else I will not fix it
- You can copy from other game or Catalog games then wear them inside Catalog Avatar Creator
- Respect Everyone
- Have fun Larping
